name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
also_check: Land must be in the family's name. Excluded: income-tax payers, institutional landholders, serving/retired government employees (except MTS/Group D), registered professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs), pensioners with Rs 10,000+/month.
benefit_note: Rs 6,000 per year per family, paid as 3 instalments of Rs 2,000 by DBT
documents: Land ownership records (7/12 extract in Maharashtra)
apply: pmkisan.gov.in > New Farmer Registration, or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY

routes.label: low-income household (must be on SECC-2011 / state beneficiary list)

also_check: Under-70 households qualify only if listed in SECC-2011 or the state's beneficiary list. Check the name on beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
benefit_note: Free hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year (health cover, not cash)
apply: beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app; or any empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)

routes.label: adult woman from a poor household without LPG

also_check: Household must be poor (Deprivation Declaration) and have no LPG connection from any oil company.
benefit_note: Deposit-free LPG connection, free first refill and stove; Rs 300 subsidy per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 9 refills a year (up to Rs 2,700/year)
apply: pmuy.gov.in or nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharat Gas, HP Gas)

name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme)

routes.label: adult wanting to start a new micro-enterprise

also_check: New units only. Projects above Rs 10 lakh (manufacturing) / Rs 5 lakh (service) need class 8 pass. No income ceiling.
benefit_note: One-time margin-money subsidy of 15-35% of project cost (max project Rs 50 lakh manufacturing, Rs 20 lakh service/business)
apply: kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal; EDP training is mandatory before subsidy release

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students

routes.label: SC student in a post-matric course, family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh

also_check: Must be enrolled in a recognised post-matric / post-secondary course. A raise of the income limit to Rs 4.5 lakh has been proposed; check the National Scholarship Portal for the current limit.
benefit_note: Full compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed plus a yearly academic allowance (amount depends on the course group)
apply: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or the state portal (MahaDBT in Maharashtra)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)

routes.label: parent/guardian of a girl child under 10

also_check: Maximum 2 accounts per family (3 for twins/triplets). Account in the girl's name.
benefit_note: Savings account for a girl child at 8.2% interest (Oct-Dec 2026), deposits Rs 250 to Rs 1.5 lakh a year, tax-free under Section 80C
apply: Any post office or authorised bank (SBI, BoB, PNB, etc.)

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)

routes.label: Maharashtra woman aged 21-65, family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh

also_check: No family member may be an income-tax payer or a government employee. Aadhaar-linked bank account in her name.
benefit_note: Rs 1,500 per month (Rs 18,000 a year) by DBT
documents: Maharashtra domicile certificate (or ration card / birth certificate)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)

routes.label: rural family without a pucca house

also_check: Family must be on the SECC-2011 / Awaas+ list verified by the Gram Sabha.
benefit_note: One-time Rs 1.20 lakh (plain areas) or Rs 1.30 lakh (hilly/NE states) to build a pucca house, plus up to Rs 12,000 for a toilet
apply: Through the Gram Panchayat; status on pmayg.nic.in
